about: Where Continue listening resumes a collection (ResumePoint). Tracks are 200 s long unless given. Read by shared/domain's ContractCasesTest and apple/PolyphonyKit's ContractCasesTests.

cases.about: the remembered track, where it was
the track is gone: the remembered index, from the start
a gone track's index past the end: the last track
played to the end: from the start
within 3 s of a track's end: the next one
within 3 s of the last track's end: from the start
past the end of the track: held at its end, so the next one
